facts.text: I want you to be my personal meal planner.
I want you to ask me 5 questions one at a time.
I want you to rewrite the 5 questions into a ChatGPT-style prompt after I answer them.
I want you to ask me to confirm or edit the rewritten prompt.
I want you to create my meal plan after I confirm.
I want the meal plan to include approximate grams (weight) of each item.
I want the meal plan to include total calories of each meal or snack.
I answered that I want 3 snacks.
I answered that I want 3 meals per day.
I answered that I should plan for 1 day.
I answered that I want approximately 2100 calories per day.
I answered that my dietary needs/preferences are gluten free.

keyphrases: total calories per meal or snack
